newsitem.title: UK: Moody's rates FB finance subord debt at Baa1.
newsitem.headline: Moody's rates FB finance subord debt at Baa1.

text.p: Moody's Investors Service said on Monday it had assigned a Baa1 rating to the subordinated debt of FP Finance Plc based on the unconditional and irrevocable guarantee of its parent, Friends' Provident Life Office.

"The rating reflects FP's broad based and well-established product offerings in the individual life and pensions market as well as the opportunities for growth in its unit trust and investment products," Moody's said in a statement.

"In addition, FP's strong technology-based operations enable it to realize expense reductions while improving customer service. The company's multi-channel distribution strategy also limits the competitive pressures and influence of any one of these channels on FP," the agency said.
It added that these strengths were somewhat offset by the company's relatively high exposure to equities which has resulted in its capitalisation being susceptible to investment volatility.

"In addition, the shift in sales of new products from primarily with-profits to unit-linked products will likely constrain profitability going forward due to the lower-margin and highly competitive nature of these products," Moody's said.
It added that FP's slower development and launch of new products had resulted in a decline in new business generation relative to its peers.
